description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling configuration related to S3's UseArnRegion feature. It provides methods to create configuration providers based on environment variables, config files, and fallback defaults, and supports composing multiple providers with caching and memoization.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: A class providing static methods to create configuration provider functions for AWS S3 UseArnRegion, supporting environment variables, ini files, fallback, and composition with caching.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, config files, and fallback defaults, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads configuration from an ini file, optionally specified profile and filename.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options when no other sources are available.
